# Sudheer Palakurla — AI Engineer | Full-Stack Engineer | AI Solutions Architect

> Portfolio for Sudheer Palakurla, an AI Engineer, Full-Stack Engineer and AI Solutions Architect with 8+ years of software engineering experience, specialising in building AI-powered applications, LLM integrations, distributed systems and full-stack platforms.

## Recruitment

Sudheer is exploring full-time AI Engineer, Full-Stack Engineer, Senior Frontend and AI Solutions Architect / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) opportunities. He is based in London, United Kingdom, with a one-month notice period. He holds a Skilled Worker visa. Employer sponsorship is required for a new full-time position.

The eight-plus years refer to commercial software engineering experience spanning frontend, backend, distributed systems and applied AI. Current formal title: Web Designer at Brittania Consultancy Services Limited (April 2024 – Current). Scope of work: AI & application engineering. Education includes a Master of Computer Science (Data Science & AI) at Bournemouth University (Jan 2020 – Jan 2022), an MBA (HR & Finance) from Osmania University, and a B.Tech (Computer Science Engineering) from Kakatiya University. A career break is listed from June 2023 to April 2024.

## Summary & Technical Expertise

Sudheer combines practical AI engineering with strong frontend, backend, distributed systems and cloud infrastructure expertise, taking applications from customer discovery, requirements workshops and solution architecture (FDE) through development, cloud deployment and production support.

- **AI & LLM Engineering:** RAG architecture (PostgreSQL, pgvector, HNSW), prompt engineering, multi-model LLM routing and automatic failover (including local model fallback), agentic workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP), real-time voice AI (OpenAI Realtime API, Gemini Live), guardrails, tokenization/context management, and LLM evaluation, tracing, monitoring & cost optimisation.
- **Solution Architecture & FDE:** Customer discovery, requirements workshops, workflow analysis, end-to-end solution design, technical specifications, enterprise integration, stakeholder communication, PoC-to-production delivery and customer-environment deployments.
- **Distributed Systems & Messaging:** Microservices, event-driven components, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, WebSockets, REST APIs, service integration, high-availability design and resilient application communication.
- **Frontend Engineering:** React.js, Next.js, Three.js, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES7+), Redux, React Hooks, Vite, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, Bootstrap, Material UI, WordPress and WooCommerce.
- **Backend & Data:** Node.js, Express.js, Python/FastAPI, PHP, REST API design, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL and Alembic schema migrations.
- **Cloud, DevOps & Infrastructure:** AWS, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE), Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Cloudflare Workers/Pages/D1/R2/KV/Workers AI, Jenkins and GitLab CI/CD.
- **Quality, AI Operations & Delivery:** LLM evaluation, tracing, monitoring and cost optimisation; Instana, SonarQube, Postman, Jest, React Testing Library, Vitest, Playwright, pytest, BrowserStack, TDD/BDD, Agile/Scrum, Jira and Confluence.

## Selected Career Impact

- Delivered or contributed to 95+ client web and e-commerce builds across UK and international markets (including 40+ responsive websites at Crazy Designers, Dec 2014 – Apr 2017, and 8+ full-stack e-commerce stores at Crazy Techsol, May 2017 – Jan 2020).
- Owned technical delivery across customer engagements, from discovery and requirements workshops through solution architecture, enterprise integration and production release.
- Designed and shipped production RAG systems using PostgreSQL, pgvector and HNSW indexing to support AI-assisted search and in-app guidance.
- Implemented multi-model LLM routing, provider fallback, evaluation, tracing, monitoring and cost-optimisation practices for production AI workflows.
- Led legacy-to-React / TypeScript / Next.js / Three.js migrations that improved application performance and maintainability by 30–40%; test automation initiatives reduced production defects by approximately 40%.
- Built real-time voice AI using the OpenAI Realtime API with automatic fallback to Gemini Live to maintain conversational continuity during provider outages.

## Featured AI Case Studies & Enterprise Projects

- **School & Case-Management ERP RAG Assistant:** Semantic search and contextual in-app guidance using PostgreSQL, pgvector and HNSW indexing with multi-model LLM routing and local-model fallback. Case study: https://sudheercv.vercel.app/#project-rag
- **AI-Driven SaaS & Real-Time Voice AI Platform (Sole Engineer):** Built with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, HNSW, Alembic, OpenAI Realtime API with Gemini Live fallback, multi-model LLM orchestration, deployed on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Case study: https://sudheercv.vercel.app/#project-voice
- **Serverless Client-Onboarding Platform:** Built on Cloudflare Pages, Workers and Hono, with D1 for relational data, KV for caching, R2 for object storage and Workers AI. Case study: https://sudheercv.vercel.app/#project-edge
- **Betfred.com — Enterprise Betting and Gaming Platform:** Distributed services and real-time gaming functionality using React, TypeScript, Redux, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, WebSockets, OKE/Kubernetes, Terraform, Instana and payment integrations.
- **GetMyHotels — AI-Powered Hotel Booking Platform:** Customer-facing search and booking workflows using Kafka, Redis, Terraform, WebSockets and payment integrations.
- **3 Bolt Court — Legal Services Platform:** Digital legal platform and internal case/clocking systems using Microservices, Redis caching, Terraform and payment integrations.
